basis: Craniosynostosis, joint contractures, scoliosis, cleft palate and external-ear malformation are defining congenital abnormalities.

decisions.otologic: primary: external-ear malformation is a defining component; primary anatomical involvement does not require demonstrated hearing loss.

basis: Inherited coagulation disorder; thrombosis is a separately diagnosed consequence. Destructive skin disease chiefly concerns severe recessive forms or treatment, not most patients.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: protein C deficiency defines a coagulation defect; DVT is a separately diagnosed consequence rather than intrinsic vessel disease.

basis: Collagen VI myopathy causes muscle degeneration and contractures. Skin and renal findings in single patients do not establish common damaging involvement.

decisions.dermatologic: none: keratosis pilaris/hyperkeratosis in 1/1 assessed patient does not establish damaging skin involvement in at least 30% of this subtype.

basis: Skeletal dysplasia; anal atresia/tongue hamartoma 2/2; major cardiac defects each 1/2. Pulmonary hypoplasia is reported, but its subtype frequency is unspecified.

decisions.pulmonary: none: subtype-specific pulmonary hypoplasia frequency is unestablished; skeletal thoracic restriction alone does not demonstrate direct lung damage.

basis: Retinal occupation defines the ocular site; malignant lymphoid cells establish the haematologic axis, and lymphoma requires infectious_immune.

decisions.haematologic: primary: lymphoma is a malignancy of lymphoid blood cells, including when its anatomical site is extranodal.

basis: Exostoses, skull defects and neurodevelopmental disability characterize the syndrome; developmental delay 80-99%, ID 7/10. Strabismus (30-79%) impairs ocular alignment/binocular function.

decisions.neurologic: primary: neurodevelopmental disability is a characteristic syndrome component, supported by developmental delay in 80-99% and intellectual disability in 7/10.
decisions.ocular: involved: persistent strabismus occurs in 30-79% and impairs ocular alignment and binocular function; nystagmus alone would be insufficient.

basis: Developmental disability and scalp aplasia occur in 3/3; urethral hypospadias in 3/3 supports urinary involvement. Minor digit shape abnormalities do not establish locomotor impairment.

decisions.renal: involved: hypospadias in 3/3 is a direct congenital urethral defect; the renal axis explicitly includes the urethra.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none: clinodactyly and overlapping digits establish minor dysmorphism without demonstrated skeletal or locomotor dysfunction; cutaneous syndactyly is a skin finding.

basis: Calcium-sensing/electrolyte disorder. Nephrocalcinosis 12/27 may reflect treatment or non-impairing deposits; reduced GFR occurs in only 2/20. Hypocalcemic spasms/seizures do not prove lasting damage.

decisions.renal: none: nephrocalcinosis in 12/27 does not establish untreated functional damage; treatment can contribute, and reduced GFR is reported in only 2/20.

basis: Microtia and cleft palate define it; developmental delay 20/20 and thenar atrophy 30-79%. Renal fusion/ectopia occurs in 30-79%, but functional renal damage is not established.

decisions.renal: none: horseshoe kidney and crossed fused ectopia are positional/fusion abnormalities; common functional renal damage is not demonstrated.
decisions.neurologic: involved: developmental delay occurs in 20/20 and intellectual disability in 30-79%; these directly impair neurologic function.
decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: thenar muscle atrophy occurs in 30-79% and represents direct skeletal-muscle tissue loss.

basis: Heme synthesis disorder with fragile skin 2/2 and blistering/scarring; neurodevelopmental impairment/neuropathy and high myopia each 1/1. Skeletal findings 1/1 omitted at cap; tiny series.

decisions.ocular: involved: high myopia in 1/1 assessed patient establishes persistent visual dysfunction; confidence is limited by the tiny series.
decisions.dermatologic: primary: characteristic childhood blistering, fragility and scarring establish a defining cutaneous disease component; skin fragility occurs in 2/2.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none at cap: short digits and delayed skeletal maturation each reported in 1/1; retain neurologic and ocular dysfunction as the more consequential involvement.
